question: Where is the breath-filled vital air said to be situated in living beings?
premises: The subject is the air filled with breath.
This air is described as situated.
Its location is in all beings.
inference: Therefore the breath-filled vital air is situated in all living beings.
uncertainties: Agreement of saṃsthitam with vāyuḥ is irregular in form.
plain_english: The breath-filled vital air is situated in all living beings.
